wo-jpfa-JR44.d:
Job Summary**

Responsible for accurately tallying and recording feed production and raw material usage at the RPU Megaluh facility, ensuring efficient inventory management and data integrity.

Job Responsibilities**

* Perform accurate counting and recording of incoming and outgoing raw materials (e.g., corn, soy meal, additives) at the RPU Megaluh.
* Record finished feed production quantities and types.
* Verify quantities against delivery notes, production orders, and other relevant documentation.
* Identify and report discrepancies or damaged goods immediately to the supervisor.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date inventory records, both manually and using designated software/systems.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly tally reports as required.
* Assist in physical stock counts and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure adherence to safety procedures and company policies within the work area.
* Collaborate with warehouse, production, and quality control teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain a clean and organized work environment.

Job Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Proven experience as a tallyman, inventory clerk, or in a similar role, preferably within a manufacturing or agricultural environment.
* Strong mathematical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to accurately count and record data.
* Familiarity with basic inventory management principles.
* Proficient in using basic office software (e.g., Microsoft Excel) for data entry and reporting.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Physically able to lift and move materials as required.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including shifts, as needed.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-jpfa-JR5285.d:
Job Summary

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical PPIC (Production Planning and Inventory Control) Staff member to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning production schedules, monitoring inventory levels, and ensuring that raw materials are available to meet production demands efficiently. You will play a vital role in balancing supply and demand to optimize our manufacturing processes and support the company's commitment to high-quality food and agribusiness solutions.
Placement : Krian

Job Responsibilities:

* Develop, implement, and monitor daily and weekly production schedules based on sales forecasts and capacity constraints.
* Manage and monitor inventory levels of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods to minimize excess stock while preventing shortages.
* Coordinate closely with the Procurement department to ensure timely delivery of raw materials.
* Collaborate with the Production team to monitor manufacturing progress and address any deviations from the plan.
* Analyze and report on production efficiency, inventory turnover, and material usage variances.
* Maintain accurate records in the ERP system regarding inventory movements and production planning data.
* Assist in identifying bottlenecks in the supply chain and propose continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.

Job Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in Production Planning and Inventory Control (PPIC), preferably within the manufacturing, food, or agribusiness industries (fresh graduates with strong internship experience in PPIC are welcome to apply).
* Proficiency in operating ERP systems (such as SAP) and advanced skills in Microsoft Excel.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and numerical skills.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
